[line]
[b]
[size=5][color=#8BC34A]📢 THE REBIRTH: WHAT'S NEW IN VERSION 2.0?[/color][/size]
Forget old, abandoned, or broken versions! GreenUpgrades V2 has been completely re-engineered from the ground up for Stardew Valley 1.6.

Every single map, script, and feature has been extensively in-game tested, proving that hoeing, watering, aging, and automated fertilization work with 100% flawless reliability.

[list]
[/b]
[*][b] 100% Stardew Valley 1.6 & SMAPI 4.0 Native: Built with modern Content Patcher architecture and optimized C# SMAPI integration.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Guaranteed Diggable Soil: Every single field tile on Levels 1 and 2 is 100% tillable and plantable. No more hoeing glitches![/b][/*]
[*][b]Intelligent Automated Nutrient Tank: Deposit fertilizer once and let the greenhouse automatically nourish your crops every morning.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Sprinkler-Free Daily Auto-Watering: Never lose farming space to sprinklers again.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Zero-Loss Chest Relocation: Upgrading will never trap or delete your chests, machines, or Junimo chests. They are safely and silently moved to the paved walkway.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Tree & Crop Relocation: Move fruit trees and living crops inside the greenhouse without resetting their growth.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Underground Aging Cellar: Maximize your profits with a dedicated wine & cheese aging area.[/b]
[/*]

Downloads.Description: The definitive multi-level Greenhouse mod for Stardew Valley 1.6! Features 15x15 & 20x20 farmable fields, aging cellar, daily auto-watering, smart fertilizer tank, safe chest protection & tree relocation. Fully tested, bug-free & easy to install!
